items.text: HEG Graphite (renamed HEG Limited on 12 October 2026) lists in late October: add it to its sector note once it trades, with its ₹650cr electrode expansion to 115,000 tonnes (due early 2028) as a project.
Compare the exchange transcript pull with Tijori for the Q2 season, then decide whether to retire Tijori.
SKF India has filed Q2 results: put it into the Bearings live table.

Run an add-companies session for the 69 recently listed or moved companies flagged 'Not in the … note' on 20 October (Behari Lal, Hy-Tech, Lohia, Bonfiglioli, Vedanta's four demerged companies, Orkla India, JSW Cement, Physicswallah and others across 30 notes); each needs the full add-company brief, which is too much for the weekly reviews.
24 capacity-picture follow-ups (milestone dates that no longer match, raised 23 October) have waited a week behind the 40-a-run limit: run a session to fix each milestone and redraw its picture.

Seven 'Big holder change' follow-ups (Chalet, Entero, Northern ARC, Piramal Pharma, RateGain, Apollo Tyres, Crompton), the Rishabh call drift and two project follow-ups (Ather, E2E) have waited over a week behind the 40-a-run limit while results calls took priority: run a session to clear them.
